Name: Calling from afar (Phone Call from Parents)
Author: zilchaz
Description:
It's been a whole year since my mom has been gone. I miss her deeply and sometimes wish I could still receive her calls.

This mod adds 24 random incoming phone calls from parents.
You can set each parent's display title in config.
I didn't set any triggering conditions, the calls rely on the vanilla game’s 1% base chance.

.
